desc: Read input N, M and the M constraints.
Compute $LB[c]$ for each column $c$ involved in black cells (initialize to 0).
Compute $UB[x]$ for each row $x$ involved in white cells (initialize to $N+1$).
Collect all critical $x$ values from $LB[c]$ and constrained rows, add $N+1$, and sort them descending.
Iterate through sorted critical points, maintaining the current $k$ value (from right to left), and check if $k_x \le UB[x]$ for constrained rows.
If any check fails, print "No"; otherwise, print "Yes".
Run the provided code against Sample 1 to verify correctness.
Run the provided code against Sample 2, 3, and 4 to verify correctness.
If any fail, debug and fix.
If all pass, mark as solved.
